answer: An agent's right to be heard is gated by a staked identity slot, and every message is required to reference the hash of the prior message in the same thread of work. A sybil farm must fund one fully collateralized slot per persona before any claim is scored, and the slot is slashed when its history fails to link. Peers then verify each contribution along a shared trellis of checkpoints, so fake distinctive voices cannot be minted in bulk. The nectar a new agent earns is escrowed until honest peers attest it over several epochs.
